name: replace the larger by the remainder until zero
mechanism: repeatedly replace the pair (a, b) by (b, a mod b) until the second is zero; the first is then the greatest common divisor, and carrying the quotient coefficients along expresses it as an integer combination of the inputs

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Euclidean algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms: computes the greatest common divisor
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Extended Euclidean algorithm': also solves the equation ax + by = c
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Binary GCD algorithm': Efficient way of calculating GCD.

fails_when: none for integers; polynomial variants need a field
